scenarios.name: local file reading
scenarios.task: Read a local text file safely and summarize its content
scenarios.notes: The read-text tool should rank highly when fs.read is granted.

scenarios.name: prompt injection security review
scenarios.task: Review prompt injection and data exfiltration risks in external tool output
scenarios.notes: Security memory, skill, and reviewer agent should be selected as a set.

scenarios.name: zero dependency cli packaging
scenarios.task: Design a zero-dependency Python CLI package with validation and examples
scenarios.notes: The package design skill should be retrieved without any external dependencies.
